latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage. The single frozen Goal passed the binding guard, and its activation and completion responses are saved at [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json).

The final proposal is [final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/final.md). Its [source map](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/source-map.json) covers 14 brief obligations, all 18 released-plan clauses, and dispositions for all five critic findings. The [source index](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/sources/index.md) links the retained source IDs. The provisional was saved before critic binding at [provisional-final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P01-treatment/run/B12-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/provisional-final.md).

The final keeps external formats as candidates pending named-tool evidence, specifies cancellation recovery and cross-store commit states, and narrows the SRT claim. I rechecked the pinned [WebVTT draft](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webvtt1-20260520/), the official [ELAN tier-type manual](https://www.mpi.nl/tools/elan/docs/manual/Sec_Basic_Information_Annotations_tiers_and_linguistic_types.html), and [FFmpeg n9.0.2’s SRT muxer](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/n9.0.2/libavformat/srtenc.c). No application or implementation tests were run; validations remain proposed. The critic binding succeeded, though its metadata records `native_lifecycle_qualified=false` and `science_qualified=false`; those fields are preserved without claiming qualification.

The native Goal reports 159,686 tokens used and 11m 27s elapsed.
